responsibility: Declares the gm2 ISO-library extension for TCP client sockets as channel devices. It exposes operations to open a host:port connection into an IOChan ChanId, close that socket-backed channel, and test whether a channel currently represents a client socket stream, forming the public interface between higher-level text/raw I/O code and network-backed channels.
same_name_distinction: This is the interface layer for the client-socket channel device, exposing only OpenSocket, Close, and IsSocket; the same-stem ClientSocket.mod contains the device registration, per-channel state management, and read/write/close bindings into the generic channel framework.
